description:
List a company's narrative disclosures

Returns a paginated list of the narrative disclosures a company has filed: accounting policies, segment descriptions, debt terms, contingencies and the other text blocks that accompany the statements.

Disclosure text is not included here. A single filing can carry hundreds of kilobytes across its text blocks, so a listing returns each disclosure's identity and `char_count`, and the text is read one disclosure at a time from `/v1/edgar/disclosures/{disclosure_id}`.

Deterministic ordering: period_of_report desc, then concept, with a tie-break on the disclosure identifier.

A company with no extracted disclosures returns an empty page rather than an error.

accession_id.description: Optional accession to restrict the listing to.

cik.description: Company CIK as digits (for example 0000320193), or a ticker symbol (for example AAPL). A ticker resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none.

page_size.description: Items per page, 1 to 200, default 50. A larger value is served as 200, and the response's page_size reports the size used.

period_of_report.description: Optional exact period the filing reports on (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: edgar_companies_disclosures
